user_observed_export_settings.source_platform: FCC National Broadband Map, Area Comparison, Fixed Broadband
user_observed_export_settings.speed_threshold: at least 100 Mbps download / 20 Mbps upload (100/20 Mbps)
user_observed_export_settings.record_provenance: Recorded as user-observed export settings from the FCC interface, not embedded metadata within the CSV.

field_semantic_documentation.geography_id: 5-digit county FIPS code (string, preserving leading zeros).
field_semantic_documentation.geography_desc_full: Geographic area name and state/territory postal abbreviation.
field_semantic_documentation.geography_type_total_units: Unit-count field from the export whose exact denominator semantics were not verified in authoritative documentation. Do not use this field as a denominator for the planned analysis.
field_semantic_documentation.data_type_total_units: Unit-count field corresponding to the selected data type filter. In this export, identical to geography_type_total_units in 100% of populated records.
field_semantic_documentation.percent_coverage: FCC served-unit percentage for the user-observed export filters (fixed broadband availability meeting or exceeding 100 Mbps download / 20 Mbps upload from all wired technologies: cable, fiber, DSL).
field_semantic_documentation.semantic_limitation_note: Official FCC documentation does not define an explicit mathematical formula linking unit count columns to percent_coverage in the summary export. No undocumented equation is assumed.

metadata.disclaimer: This audit evaluates source-data integrity of the FCC export and geographic join compatibility with Census ACS Table B28002. FCC percent_coverage reflects facility-based fixed broadband network availability (at >=100/20 Mbps threshold) reported by service providers, whereas Census Table B28002 measures household-reported broadband internet subscriptions. This audit does not establish project feasibility, a causal relationship, or a quantified adoption-availability gap.

fcc_file_exists_and_nonempty.description: FCC CSV file exists on disk and is nonempty.

fcc_header_schema.description: Header columns match expected five fields in exact order.

fcc_record_structure_valid.description: Every CSV record has exact expected column width (no surplus fields under None key and no structurally absent fields with value None).

fcc_geography_id_format.description: Every geography_id is a nonempty string of exactly five digits preserving leading zeros.

fcc_geography_id_unique.description: No duplicate geography IDs exist in the FCC export.

fcc_geography_desc_nonempty.description: Every geography description is a non-empty string.

fcc_percent_coverage_valid.description: percent_coverage parses as a finite float within [0.0, 1.0] for every row.

fcc_unit_counts_valid_when_present.description: geography_type_total_units and data_type_total_units are nonnegative integers when present.

missing_unit_counts_review.description: Report observed missing unit counts in FCC export (preserved as empty string, not converted to zero).
missing_unit_counts_review.notes: Observed 2 records with empty unit count fields: 60030 (Rose Island, AS), 69085 (Northern Islands Municipality, MP). These values were faithfully retained as missing rather than coerced to zero.

unit_counts_agreement_diagnostic.description: Comparison between geography_type_total_units and data_type_total_units where both exist.
unit_counts_agreement_diagnostic.notes: In all 3232 records where both unit count fields are populated, geography_type_total_units equals data_type_total_units exactly (100% agreement).

geographic_compatibility.status_notes: Unmatched geography IDs reflect known nonfatal boundary-vintage changes (Connecticut planning regions) and geographic scope differences (island territories), which are distinct from hard source-integrity failures.
geographic_compatibility.disclaimer: Exact geographic ID matching does not prove identical boundary definitions or conceptual equivalence of provider-reported availability and household-reported subscription measures.

unmatched_analysis.boundary_alignment_findings: The 9 Census-only records correspond to Connecticut's planning regions (FIPS 09110-09190), adopted as county-equivalents in the 2024 ACS 5-year data. The FCC Area Comparison export retains Connecticut's 8 legacy counties (FIPS 09001-09015). Do not perform an unverified many-to-many crosswalk or spatial allocation without formal methodological authorization. The remaining 13 FCC-only records represent island territories (American Samoa [5], Guam [1], Northern Mariana Islands [4], and U.S. Virgin Islands [3]) not included in the standard Census 50 States + DC + PR county extract.
